title: There Should Be No Harm
arabic_text: عَنْ [أَبِي سعيدٍ سعدِ بنِ سِنانٍ الخُدْريِّ] رَضِي اللهُ عَنْهُ، أنَّ messenger of Allah صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قالَ: "لاَ ضَرَرَ وَلاَ ضِرَارَ ".
english_translation: From Abū Saʿīd Saʿd bin Sinān al-Khudrī (raḍiyallāhu ʿanhu), that the Messenger of Allāh (ṣallallāhu ʿalayhi wasallam) said, 'There should be neither harming nor reciprocating harm.'
description: This Hadith establishes the principle that neither causing harm to others nor reciprocating harm is permitted in Islam. It is a fundamental principle of Islamic law regarding interpersonal relations.
